description:
Create a new Image Style named 'Product Main (600x600)' (machine name: product_main_600) that scales and crops images to exactly 600x600 pixels. Then, configure the 'Default' product variation type's display settings to use this new image style for the Product image field.

Starting from the Image Styles configuration page, you must:
1. Add the new image style.
2. Add the 'Scale and crop' effect with 600x600 dimensions.
3. Navigate to the Product Variation Types configuration.
4. Manage the display of the 'Default' variation type.
5. Update the Image field to use your new image style.
